third-party MCP and tool content may carry residual PII: generations stay outside git (P15); only counts, hashes and measurements enter the repository

schema_synth's gold call is computed by its program from a sampled ground truth, never by a model, and is task material and reference verification only: every assistant turn a student trains on is its own teacher's

what its levels establish (schema_synth_audit.VERIFICATION_STRENGTH): schema validity is a structural check; step_gold an exact comparison with the program's reference call; recorded execution a hit in a replay table keyed by that same call -- not an independent backend and not closed-loop task success; step_gold and the replay hit are ONE piece of correctness evidence; the tasks are G2, never reported as G1 environment success
the generator's instances are a pure function of (version, domain, index): no admitted task is edited; more material is a later instance range under a new extension content and a new signed admission
its three state-evaluation domains test domain hold-out under a shared generator, not generalization to real unseen tool-calling tasks, which needs an independent real tool-calling evaluation
